original_commit_restoration: The incremental original-source.bundle needs its original parent. For stacked checkpoints, restore the parent checkpoint bundle first. The GitHub source commit has the exact original tree but different commit metadata.
publication_scope: Existing source and historical software evidence only; no new tests, target build, merge, tag, firmware release, deployment, or hardware acceptance is claimed.
historical_reports: Reports and logs are preserved from before publication; local-only/unpublished statements describe that earlier observation. This source lock supersedes only their publication state.
